faqsData.question: Do you provide 24x7 emergency and accidental trauma services?
faqsData.answer: Yes, MP Hospital and Trauma Centre operates a round-the-clock (24/7) emergency trauma unit with immediate casualty reception, on-call trauma surgeons, anesthesiologists, digital X-ray, in-house pharmacy, and Advanced Life Support (ALS) ambulances. Call our emergency hotline at 0761-2626123 or +91 76489-98668.

faqsData.question: Is MP Hospital the same as Maxx Hospital?
faqsData.answer: Yes! MP Hospital and Trauma Centre was formerly known as Maxx Hospital & Trauma Centre. We have rebranded and modernized our healthcare infrastructure under the leadership of Dr. Abhishek Jain, continuing our 10+ year legacy of trusted orthopedic, spine, and trauma care in Jabalpur.

faqsData.question: What are the OPD consultation timings for Dr. Abhishek Jain?
faqsData.answer: Dr. Abhishek Jain (Orthopedic Surgeon & Trauma Specialist) is available for OPD consultations Monday through Saturday. Morning OPD is generally 10:30 AM to 1:30 PM and evening OPD is 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM. We strongly recommend booking your appointment online or calling +91 76489-98668 prior to visiting.

faqsData.question: Do you accept Ayushman Bharat and Cashless Mediclaim Insurance?
faqsData.answer: Yes, we accept major health insurance policies, corporate TPAs, and cashless mediclaim. Our dedicated TPA helpdesk assists patients and families with quick pre-authorization, seamless document verification, and cashless discharge processing.

faqsData.question: What types of joint replacement and orthopedic surgeries are done?
faqsData.answer: We perform Total Knee Replacement (TKR), Total Hip Replacement (THR), Shoulder Arthroplasty, Minimally Invasive Arthroscopic Ligament Repairs (ACL/PCL/Meniscus), Complex Trauma & Pelvic Fractures, and Pediatric Orthopedic Surgeries inside state-of-the-art modular laminar airflow operation theatres.
